mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain disruption regimes, a decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index) indicates constrained manufacturing output that increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during supply chain disruption when INDPRO is below 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly expansion in real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals sustained economic momentum that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 shows quarterly growth, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% indicates persistent price pressures that trigger aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) above their 3-month moving averages signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both PAYEMS and UNRATE are in the specified state, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market recovery regimes, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1200.0 (thousands of units) signals renewed consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during housing market recovery when HOUST exceeds 1200.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
